gen-gf-unica-one-space-grotesk: Space Grotesk keeps its curves open and its lowercase moderate, a steady ribbon of a line. Unica One is the loud one, with a very large lowercase eye and daylight inside every curve.
gen-gf-unkempt-fs-hind: Rough, loud and a bit rumpled, Unkempt makes its t with crossbar and stem matching, while Hind stays tidy beneath it. Unkempt earns its keep big and brief.
gen-gf-unkempt-fs-nunito: Expressive Unkempt keeps its c clearly apart from its o. Nunito follows with big round bowls and terminals that finish well clear of the stem, so the body feels approachable beside it.
gen-gf-unkempt-fs-pilcrow-rounded: Commanding Unkempt gives its t a crossbar and stem of matching weight, and its gaps keep c from collapsing into o. Pilcrow Rounded, a plain sans, is warmer, with big counters and curves that refuse to close.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-alan-sans: Unkempt draws its lines with no pressure swells, so the eye never slows down inside a letter, while Alan Sans holds its curve tails well back. That makes the pair feel crisp.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-alef: Scrappy and bold, Unkempt draws with a constant-width pen line, and its t has crossbar and stem to match. Alef follows with open-ended curves, so a long passage in this sans goes down smoothly.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-alegreya-sans-sc: Unkempt holds its stroke at fixed stylus pressure, so its t has a crossbar and stem of matching weight and its c never turns into an o. Alegreya Sans SC adds an open, welcoming gap.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-amarna: Unkempt is a display face whose t has crossbar and stem of matching weight, with gaps that keep c apart from o. Amarna steps in, sans-serif and contrast-free.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-andika: A t with crossbar and stem of matching weight marks Unkempt, and its gaps keep c from turning into o. Andika's sans-serif tails and terminals match its stems, so give it a modest size.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-antic: Rough-hewn and commanding, Unkempt gives its t a crossbar and stem of matching weight, plus gaps that keep c from looking like o. Antic, a plain sans, reads as if drawn with one nib.
